latestVersion.changelog: Initial public release v1.0.0: offline ASR via whisper.cpp (whisper-cli) + ffmpeg; cross-platform installer (macOS/Linux) with Windows WSL2 recommendation; auto-download models to assets/models; optional sha256 verification; safer temp dir (mktemp).
